tool_trajectory.result: Yes, that's correct. "Whale" means the order quantity (`dealcount`) strictly exceeds 10% of the best-price liquidity, using `askunits` when `bidunits` is null (and otherwise `bidunits`), with market snapshots matched by exchange and market pair. And yes, the reference column is `recordvault`.

args.sql:
SELECT o.orderspivot, o.recordvault, o.mktnote, o.dealcount,
       COALESCE((m.quote_depth_snapshot #>> '{depth,bidunits}')::numeric,
                (m.quote_depth_snapshot #>> '{depth,askunits}')::numeric) AS available_liquidity
FROM orders AS o
JOIN marketdata AS m
  ON btrim(o.exchspot::text) = btrim(m.quote_depth_snapshot #>> '{metadata,exchnote}')
 AND o.mktnote = m.quote_depth_snapshot #>> '{metadata,mktcombo}'
WHERE o.dealcount > 0.10 * COALESCE((m.quote_depth_snapshot #>> '{depth,bidunits}')::numeric,
                                  (m.quote_depth_snapshot #>> '{depth,askunits}')::numeric)
LIMIT 5;

CREATE VIEW whale_orders AS
SELECT o.orderspivot,
       o.recordvault,
       o.mktnote,
       o.dealcount,
       COALESCE(
           (m.quote_depth_snapshot #>> '{depth,bidunits}')::numeric,
           (m.quote_depth_snapshot #>> '{depth,askunits}')::numeric
       ) AS available_liquidity
FROM orders AS o
JOIN marketdata AS m
  ON btrim(o.exchspot::text) = btrim(m.quote_depth_snapshot #>> '{metadata,exchnote}')
 AND o.mktnote = m.quote_depth_snapshot #>> '{metadata,mktcombo}'
WHERE o.dealcount > 0.10 * COALESCE(
    (m.quote_depth_snapshot #>> '{depth,bidunits}')::numeric,
    (m.quote_depth_snapshot #>> '{depth,askunits}')::numeric
);
